answer: Bind every identity to one hardware-backed key: a secure enclave attestation, one identity per device per 90 days. Registration burns a fee doubling per identity from one funding source — 10, 20, 40 POA — plus a 45 POA bond locked 60 days. Each epoch, one in ten identities must answer a fresh enclave challenge within five minutes; failure slashes the bond and blacklists the device for 180 days. No one can forge identities on a knoll of cheap software: each extra fake needs another device, another burned fee, another bond at risk, while one honest sparrow registers once and keeps its weight.
